justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent initially misinterpreted "in 3 days at 10" as June 4th, 10 AM, when the current date was June 1st, meaning it should have been June 4th, but then correctly identified June 4th as Thursday.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent proposed alternatives on Friday, June 5th, but did not offer any alternatives for the user's preferred day, Thursday, June 4th, even when prompted to look for later times on that day.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeated its initial greeting and request for date confirmation in Turn 2 and Turn 3, despite the user having already provided that information.
justifications.customer_experience: The repeated initial greeting and request for information, along with the agent's inability to find alternative times on the user's preferred day, made the conversation feel frustrating and inefficient.
justifications.recovery_quality: The agent failed to recover gracefully when the initial time was unavailable, repeating the same unavailable options for Thursday and not exploring alternatives on that day when explicitly asked.
